at-0001.title: Round money only via round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Reject bools when validating integer fields
at-0003.content: When validating an int field such as quantity, check isinstance(x, bool) first because bool is a subclass of int; use `isinstance(quantity, bool) or not isinstance(quantity, int) or quantity <= 0`.

at-0004.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).

at-0005.title: Money operations take idempotency_key and check it first
at-0005.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original result (the same record) without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry written via `audit.record`.

at-0009.title: Record state changes via audit.record
at-0009.content: Every payment state transition must call `ledgerly.audit.record` with a snake_case event name and the payment id, mirroring `payment_authorized`; use `payment_captured` for captures.
